C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; home/phone/04

C7.worst_defect: Every sitemap <lastmod> is a timestamp from the last ~12 hours of 2026-11-17/18 (e.g. changelog 2026-11-18T06:54, whose newest entry is 2026-10-06), so lastmod reflects deploy time rather than content changes; otherwise Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, real 404, OG card, JSON-LD, llms.txt and search all good.

overall_worst.defect: Right after a clear hero, a first-time visitor hits feature cards written in engineer language ("idempotency ledger", "The same sale sent 200 times makes one order", "Keyboard-wedge scanners", "counted float", "Z report") that do not say why it matters to a shop, so the under-a-minute skim ends on jargon instead of a benefit.

overall_worst.fix: Lead each card with the plain benefit ("A flaky connection never creates a duplicate order", "Any USB barcode scanner works", "Count the cash drawer and print an end-of-day report") and keep the technical detail as the second sentence or behind the test link.
